title: A Different Person
paragraphs: “In the town two places over… it seems so.”
“The guild manages information on a town-by-town basis. Maybe he came to this unknown town to work?”
“If that’s the case, then he should be trying to become more famous. So why would he run away from the heroes?”
“As an adventurer, that’s strange. Wouldn’t it be better to curry favor?”
“Now that you mention it… that’s true.”
Father and the others tilted their heads in confusion. Is it really that strange?
“Aren’t you overthinking it?”
“Well, yeah… but maybe he’s trying to get us to notice him and drag us into some negotiation? I mean, we are curious about him now.”
“That might be the case.”
“Yeah. But a commotion like that happens all the time with adventurers.”
Father and the others seemed ready to put that adventurer out of their minds. However, Ren, looking somewhat uneasy, continued the conversation.
“But… doesn’t that guy, Yuta or whatever, resemble Takt?”
“…Well, now that you mention it.”
“I think so too. He only had three people with him, but the fact that he’s surrounded by multiple women is concerning.”
Oh? Now that they mention it, that part is indeed similar. Dragging along pigs makes him look the same.
“Isn’t it a bit much to suspect him just for that?”
“Couldn’t he be the Projectile Hero or something?”
“I wonder… Was that guy just now the Projectile Hero?” Father asked someone who knew the face.
Oh? This person was here?
“I’m pretty sure it’s a completely different person. Even the voice is different.”
Well, if it was the real one, he would’ve said something by now. The fact that he didn’t say anything means he’s someone else.
“But isn’t it possible to disguise the face and voice with magic?”
“If we go down that route, there’s no end to it.”
“That’s the real problem. It’s going to be tough identifying the Seven Star Heroes.”
“Can’t we just do what Motoyasu did when he took the Seven Star Weapon from Takt?”
“That wouldn’t work on someone who was chosen properly.”

That was something we found out when that Trash tried it in the previous loop. Most likely, it was only possible because he obtained the Seven Star Weapon through illegitimate means. Or maybe, recalling what the Father from the first world said, unless the Seven Star Weapon itself abandons its wielder, revoking the qualification isn’t possible.
“So it wouldn’t work on someone hiding?”
“Does a hero who doesn’t participate in the waves or protect the world even deserve that title?”
“Shall we test it out next time?”
“No, hold on. That guy is innocent.”
Ren declared it outright.
“Why’s that?”
“Think carefully, Naofumi. About the traits of us heroes.”
“Ah… right. We can’t use anything other than the weapons we were chosen for in combat. From what I saw of the match earlier, he was using a one-handed sword.”
“Wouldn’t that be a gray area since it’s a projectile weapon? The category seems broad.”
“I’ve heard of throwing knives, but isn’t it a stretch to call such a long sword a projectile weapon?”
“It depends on interpretation, but…”
There are types of weapons where the classification is ambiguous. For example, in my case, is a halberd considered a spear or an axe? Apparently, it falls under the spear category.
To be precise, my spear is just a long-handled weapon. I can also handle some types of staves.
“If anything thrown counts, then sure… but Motoyasu, what kind of weapons did the Projectile Hero use in that first world you mentioned?”

That was the yandere pig who was with Itsuki. In the previous loop, Yuki-chan was chosen as the Projectile Hero. However, that was during the emergency with the revival of the Phoenix. And after Yuki-chan was chosen as the Projectile Hero, she acted separately the whole time, so I don’t know how she used her weapons. So, I’ll use the yandere pig as a reference.
“Boomerangs, throwing knives, chakrams, and the like. She mainly fought with throwing knives in close combat. I think there was also a throwing spear.”
“And that guy just now was using a one-handed sword. He was swinging it normally… and from the looks of it, it didn’t seem like a weapon meant for throwing.”
“That’s exactly it. It’s not like anything that can be thrown qualifies. Otherwise, even a shield or a stone would count as an all-purpose weapon.”
“Besides, when he won, didn’t he hand his sword over to that girl who was with him?”
Ren and Itsuki clapped their hands in realization. Ah, that’s right. Hero weapons fundamentally don’t leave the wielder’s body. So, there’s no way that Cola guy could be a hero.
“Ah… I see. That means he was borrowing that weapon.”
“Why wouldn’t he carry it himself?”
“Maybe he’s in a porter-like position, or just trying to keep a casual appearance?”
“Or maybe he was planning to have a blacksmith sharpen it?”
“Either way, if he can take the weapon off himself, then he’s in the clear. Though, since Takt was able to conceal his weapon, we can’t be too sure.”
“That guy summoned his weapon from nowhere using some kind of magical force.”

“Yeah. But if he’s handing his weapon over to someone else, that’s different. And there’s no point in overthinking it. Rather than being suspicious, it feels more like he’s trying to get noticed. Let’s change the topic.”
Ren and Itsuki nodded at Father’s suggestion. Indeed. We’ll probably never see him again, and there’s no need to remember someone like Cola.
“…Yeah, if fate allows it, we’ll meet again. It’s not like he’s harmful, and having more strong people around is good for the world. Besides, we’ve got things we need to do.”
“Exactly. We need to find the Seven Star Heroes as soon as possible.”
“I hope we can save the Seven Star Heroes that Takt killed in the first world. They were summoned heroes too, so I’d like to think we could come to an understanding if we talked to them.”
Father had the same expression as the previous version of him, back when he said he wanted to see the world.
“I want to teach the Seven Star Heroes that, just like Ren, Itsuki, and Motoyasu came to trust me, heroes can understand one another.”
“Naofumi, you’re kind.”
“Thinking of him as another version of Ren gives me a sense of familiarity.”
“You’re starting with that? Well… whatever,” Ren responded, looking slightly exasperated.
“Talking too long.”
“So long.”
Rival and Sakura-chan chimed in.
Oh? Had we really been talking that long?
“Is the time okay?” Assistant asked Father with concern.

That’s right. One way or another, we’re busy with the constant battles against the waves. We need to wrap up this troublesome task of finding the heroes quickly… and now that I think about it, I want to raise lots of Filolials.
It’s not that I’ve forgotten, but isn’t it about time I started the Filolial breeding plan?
“Should we give up on searching for the heroes and just raise a lot more Filolials to fight against the waves? Yes… I’ll raise 100 or even 1,000 of them!”
“What a wonderful idea, Motoyasu-sama!”
“Sounds fun—”
Yuki-chan and Kou agreed with my opinion. In contrast, Ren and Itsuki looked displeased.
“N-Not at all! That many Filolials would just be a nuisance!”
“Yeah. The food costs alone would be insane.”
“It sounds fun, but I don’t think raising Filolials and searching for the heroes can be done at the same time…”
Even Mole and Assistant?
Ugh! I won’t give up until I find Filo-tan!
“F-For now… let’s put this discussion on hold. Motoyasu, please manage this plan carefully, okay?”
“Understood!”
And with that, we moved on… toward the town where Cola was supposedly famous.
